attribution.localizedCause: The combined streaming FF2-transpose plus current BF16 GEGLU-backward arithmetic is not source-exact. Mismatches affect both gate and value halves, so the retained bias projection alone cannot yet distinguish the shared transpose adjoint from activation-product and derivative boundaries.

decision.rationale: Freeze a source-attributed FF2-input-adjoint capture or an equivalent independent primitive comparator before changing any activation formula; do not tune against the retained ff_bias1_19 vector.

hypothesis.rationale: The complete open projection differs from retained ff_bias1_19 in 4,708 of 6,144 BF16 words with maximum absolute error 1.52587890625e-05 despite deterministic replay and a live sign control.

retiredDimensions: The unqualified combination of one streaming FF2-transpose dot, BF16-rounded transpose output, BF16 gate-product boundary, and the current explicit unfused tanh-GELU derivative as a source-exact top-layer backward contract.
transferableLessons: Exact final-RMS and ff2_19 parameter gradients do not imply an exact FF2 input adjoint. Before propagating into ff1_19, capture or independently validate the production FF2-transpose adjoint and then test GEGLU branches separately.
uncertainties: Whether the first divergence is FF2-transpose reduction/output rounding, GEGLU multiplication rounding, GELU derivative operation order, or their composition remains unresolved.

reasons: The prospectively frozen two-population gate completed, validated all strict outputs, reproduced all 640 forward checkpoints, retained byte-identical treatment and control artifacts, and passed dependency, source, memory, scratch, and cleanup guards.
